title: Professional Certificate Course in Fundamentals of Branding
description: The aim of this course is to provide a comprehensive understanding of branding and how it can impact an organization's success.
longDescription: Concept of Brand Identity, Brand Image and the main differences between them. Concept of Brand Personality, brand positioning and the main differences. Brand Objective. Relationship between Competitive strength and brand value. How brand value enhances organisational strength Concept of corporate reputation and its element. Concept of brand association and sustainability. The aim of this course is to provide a comprehensive understanding of branding and how it can impact an organization's success. The course will cover the key concepts of brand identity, brand image, brand personality, brand positioning, and their differences. Additionally, the course will focus on brand objectives and their relationship with competitive strength and brand value. It will also delve into the concept of corporate reputation and its elements, along with brand association and sustainability. courseDetails: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of branding concepts and strategies that are crucial for creating and maintaining a successful brand. The course covers key concepts, such as brand identity, brand image, brand personality, brand positioning, and the differences between them. Participants will also learn about brand objectives and how they relate to competitive strength and brand value. The course delves into the concept of brand identity and image and the significance of creating a consistent brand identity and image. It also explores the concept of brand personality and how it can be used to create a strong brand positioning. Additionally, the course covers the importance of corporate reputation and its elements and how it can affect brand value.
